name: webhook-url-input
title: Webhook URL Input
description: Stops a webhook from being pointed somewhere events can't arrive by judging the URL for the environment it's saved to (an ngrok, tunnel, localhost or private-IP URL is an error in production but a hint in test mode, a staging host is flagged, plain http and a missing path get a fix) and diffing it against the last saved URL, warning when only a www or trailing slash changed because senders treat the resulting redirect as a failure, with a one-tap revert.
